verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs present balances, ownership, and transactions as separate data types tied to distinct use cases (ACH with balances, Connect payouts with ownership, fintech apps with transactions). That suggests data access is scoped per product rather than granted all at once, but the pack never explicitly documents a permission-selection mechanism or consent-scoping control. missing for 10: an explicit documented parameter for requesting only specific data permissions, a description of the per-scope consent shown to end users, documented data-minimization controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
